# lodash.rest v4.0.5

The [lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.rest` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.rest
```

In Node.js:
```js
var rest = require('lodash.rest');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#rest) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.0.5-npm-packages/lodash.rest) for more details.
